role: Pure resolver that finds when an activity bout ended from passive HealthKit activity windows (exercise minutes or steps), used to reconstruct a workout whose recording crashed and left no HKWorkout.
types: ActivityBoutResolver: enum — namespace with end(ofBoutStartingAt:activity:maxGap:maxDuration:) and its filter helper
state: mem:ActivityBoutResolver.maxBoutDuration (static let 21600 s, also used by HealthWorkoutImporter+Rebuild:156 as search window)

units.does: Walks usable activity windows in start order from `start`, extending a cursor to each window's end (clamped to start+maxDuration) until a window begins more than maxGap after the cursor; returns the cursor if any window extended it, else nil.

branches.cond: for each usable sample (sorted by start)
sample starts more than maxGap after cursor
branches.effect: true: break — the bout ended at cursor; false: continue processing
false: skip (window entirely covered); true: extend
true: break (bout capped at maxDuration); false: continue
true: returns cursor; false: returns nil (no activity at all after start, or the first usable window starts more than maxGap after start — a later, separate bout)

units.does: Filters windows to those with value > 0, ending after start and with positive duration, sorted by start.
